release_notes:
Updating from 1.2 or 1.3? Install this version by hand, just this once: their Download and Install button cannot start the installer. Save your work, close DALA·AEP SCP, download DALA-AEP-SCP_Setup.exe from https://github.com/roktemp29/dala-scp-releases/releases/tag/v1.4 and run it. Your projects and settings are kept. From 1.4 on, updates install from inside the app.

What's new in 1.4

- A redesigned interface: a consistent look across home, editor, timeline, Character Detect and every dialog, with clear icons and a layout that fits smaller screens.
- The timeline has a time ruler (click it to move the playhead), sharper drawing and better thumbnails.
- One Export dialog for every export: separate clips or one merged video, the audio (with audio, video only, or a separate audio file) and the folder.
- Simpler right-click menus. Scene Edit Detection is in the movie's right-click menu; CATS is now Character Detect.
- In-app updates now install correctly, also on PCs with more than one copy of the app.

Fixes
- The scene-detection screen and the guided tour are no longer hidden behind the video preview.
- "Add movie" and the timeline tabs stay inside the window at every size.
- Character colours, Preferences settings that had no effect, the Ctrl+N shortcut and other small issues.
- Uninstalling silently no longer deletes your settings and caches.
